title: OrbitEOS Energy Management
description: Energy management platform — 61 tools for solar, battery, grid, and EV charging control
summary: Energy management platform — 61 tools for solar, battery, grid, and EV charging control
offersHint: Energy management platform — 61 tools for solar, battery, grid, and EV charging control · Remote MCP (sse) at https://mcp.orbiteos.cloud/sse

toolsPreview.name: list_accounts
toolsPreview.description: List all accounts (organizations) on the platform. Root admin only.

toolsPreview.name: create_account
toolsPreview.description: Create a new account (organization) on the platform. Root admin only.

toolsPreview.name: update_account
toolsPreview.description: Update an account. Root admin only.

toolsPreview.name: list_sub_accounts
toolsPreview.description: List sub-accounts (divisions) for an account.

toolsPreview.name: create_sub_account
toolsPreview.description: Create a sub-account (division) within an account.

toolsPreview.name: update_sub_account
toolsPreview.description: Update a sub-account.

toolsPreview.name: delete_sub_account
toolsPreview.description: Delete a sub-account.

toolsPreview.name: list_sites
toolsPreview.description: List all sites accessible to the current user. Supports tree view (lazy loading by parentId) or flat list.

toolsPreview.name: search_sites
toolsPreview.description: Search sites by name, description, or location across the entire hierarchy. Returns breadcrumb paths.

toolsPreview.name: get_site
toolsPreview.description: Get detailed information about a specific site including edge mappings.

toolsPreview.name: create_site
toolsPreview.description: Create a new site in the hierarchy. Types: region, hub, site, zone. Only "site" type can have edge mappings.

toolsPreview.name: update_site
toolsPreview.description: Update a site's properties, hierarchy position, or edge mappings.

toolsPreview.name: delete_site
toolsPreview.description: Delete a site and all its children in the hierarchy.

toolsPreview.name: get_site_config
toolsPreview.description: Get the full component configuration for a site (fetched live from the energy system). Shows all controllers, meters, inverters, etc.

toolsPreview.name: list_users
toolsPreview.description: List all users in the current account. Shows name, email, role, last login, and active status.

toolsPreview.name: get_user
toolsPreview.description: Get detailed information about a specific user including their assigned sites.

toolsPreview.name: create_user
toolsPreview.description: Create a new user in the account. Assign a role and optionally specific sites.

toolsPreview.name: update_user
toolsPreview.description: Update a user's profile, role, active status, or site assignments.

toolsPreview.name: delete_user
toolsPreview.description: Deactivate a user account. Does not permanently delete — can be reactivated.

toolsPreview.name: invite_user
toolsPreview.description: Send an email invitation for someone to join the account.

toolsPreview.name: list_roles
toolsPreview.description: List all roles in the account with their permissions.

toolsPreview.name: list_permissions
toolsPreview.description: List all available permissions that can be assigned to roles.

toolsPreview.name: create_role
toolsPreview.description: Create a custom role with specific permissions.

toolsPreview.name: update_role
toolsPreview.description: Update a role's name, description, or permissions.

toolsPreview.name: delete_role
toolsPreview.description: Delete a custom role. Cannot delete system roles or roles assigned to users.

toolsPreview.name: get_live_data
toolsPreview.description: Get current live power/energy snapshot for a site. Returns grid power, solar production, consumption, battery SoC, etc.

toolsPreview.name: get_channel_value
toolsPreview.description: Get a single channel value from a site. Channels are addresses like "_sum/GridActivePower" or "ess0/Soc".

toolsPreview.name: describe_system
toolsPreview.description: Explain what OrbitEOS is, what sections the dashboard has, and what metrics are available. Useful for orientation.

toolsPreview.name: describe_site
toolsPreview.description: Get a human-readable summary of a site: what components it has, its capabilities, current status.

toolsPreview.name: query_history
toolsPreview.description: Query historical timeseries power data for a site. Returns time-indexed power values (watts) for the specified channels and date range.

toolsPreview.name: query_energy_totals
toolsPreview.description: Query cumulative energy totals (kWh) for a site over a date range. Returns production, consumption, grid import/export, battery charge/discharge.

toolsPreview.name: export_csv
toolsPreview.description: Export historical data as CSV for a site and date range.

toolsPreview.name: create_component
toolsPreview.description: Create a new component (controller, meter, inverter, etc.) on a site. Requires the factory ID and configuration properties.

toolsPreview.name: update_component
toolsPreview.description: Update configuration properties of an existing component on a site.

toolsPreview.name: delete_component
toolsPreview.description: Delete a component from a site. Use with caution — this removes the component from the energy system.

toolsPreview.name: set_channel_value
toolsPreview.description: Write a value to a writable channel on a site. Used for manual control (e.g., set EV charger power limit, force battery charge/discharge).

toolsPreview.name: check_system_health
toolsPreview.description: Check if a site's energy system is running normally. Answers "Is my system running normally?" by checking online status, battery SoC, grid connection, and component states.

toolsPreview.name: analyze_grid_usage
toolsPreview.description: Analyze why grid import is high. Compares production vs consumption patterns. Answers "Why am I importing so much from the grid?"

toolsPreview.name: compare_solar_performance
toolsPreview.description: Compare solar production across two periods. Answers "Solar seems lower than usual" by comparing recent vs previous period.

toolsPreview.name: get_energy_summary
toolsPreview.description: Get energy summary for a site over a period. Answers "How much solar did I generate this month?" or "What's my energy usage?"

toolsPreview.name: analyze_battery_usage
toolsPreview.description: Analyze battery charge/discharge patterns and provide sizing recommendations. Answers "Should I get a bigger battery?"

toolsPreview.name: get_system_log
toolsPreview.description: Get system logs for a site. Shows runtime log entries filtered by level.

toolsPreview.name: execute_command
toolsPreview.description: Execute a system command on a site's edge controller. Use with caution. Commands: restart, factoryReset, etc.

toolsPreview.name: get_platform_settings
toolsPreview.description: Get all platform configuration settings. Root admin only. Includes SMTP, branding, security, edge connection, LLM config.

toolsPreview.name: update_platform_settings
toolsPreview.description: Update platform configuration settings. Root admin only. Pass an array of {key, value} pairs.

toolsPreview.name: test_smtp
toolsPreview.description: Test SMTP email configuration by sending a test email.

toolsPreview.name: get_audit_log
toolsPreview.description: Query the audit log to see who did what and when. Shows user actions like logins, creates, updates, deletes.

toolsPreview.name: universal_search
toolsPreview.description: Search across all entities: accounts, sub-accounts, sites, users. Returns matching results with entity types.

toolsPreview.name: check_platform_health
toolsPreview.description: Check the health of the OrbitEOS platform itself (database connection, edge backend connectivity).

toolsPreview.name: list_marketplace_categories
toolsPreview.description: List all marketplace categories: Energy Devices, Cloud Integrations, Analytics, Control Strategies, Notifications, Dashboard Widgets, Data Export, Protocols, UI Apps.

toolsPreview.name: browse_plugins
toolsPreview.description: Browse available plugins in the marketplace. Filter by category, type, or search text.

toolsPreview.name: get_plugin_details
toolsPreview.description: Get detailed information about a marketplace plugin including its configuration schema and capabilities.

toolsPreview.name: install_plugin
toolsPreview.description: Install a marketplace plugin for your account. Once installed, it can be assigned to specific sites.

toolsPreview.name: list_installed_plugins
toolsPreview.description: List all plugins installed in your account, including their site assignments.

toolsPreview.name: update_plugin_config
toolsPreview.description: Update configuration of an installed plugin.

toolsPreview.name: uninstall_plugin
toolsPreview.description: Uninstall a plugin from your account. Removes all site assignments.

toolsPreview.name: assign_plugin_to_site
toolsPreview.description: Assign an installed plugin to a specific site. This creates a device/algorithm/integration instance at the site level. E.g., assign "SMA Inverter" driver to "Munich Factory" site.

toolsPreview.name: remove_plugin_from_site
toolsPreview.description: Remove a plugin assignment from a site.

toolsPreview.name: list_site_plugins
toolsPreview.description: List all plugins/devices/algorithms assigned to a specific site.

toolsPreview.name: create_marketplace_category
toolsPreview.description: Create a new marketplace category. Root admin only.

toolsPreview.name: create_plugin
toolsPreview.description: Create a new plugin in the marketplace. Root admin only.
